about: Bajaj Finance Limited operates as a deposit-taking non-banking financial company in India. The company offers financing for various products, such as consumer electronics, furniture, digital products, lifestyle products, lifecare services, e-commerce purchases, retail spends, and two and three-wheelers; and personal, unsecured, home, secured, gold, and car loans. It also provides secured and unsecured loans to micro, small, and medium enterprises; loans against property, mutual funds, insurance
